description: This Java source file defines an abstract class EventCodeProducer, which is part of a code generation framework for events. It provides methods to gather enum definitions and dependencies required for generating event-related code, and implements TemplateMappings. It is likely used as a base class for generating Java or Native code for events in a larger software project.

classes.name: EventCodeProducer
classes.description: An abstract base class for generating Java and native code related to events, providing methods to identify enums and dependencies necessary for code generation.

methods.name: getEnumsToGenerate
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumDefWrapper objects that are part of the event generation section and have not been generated yet.

methods.name: getEventDependencies
methods.description: Returns an iterator over wrappers that are dependencies for event generation, filtered by whether they are native or Java.

methods.name: scanWrappersForDependencies
methods.description: Filters wrappers based on whether they are in the event section and match the language (native or Java), adding them to the target list.
